import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv', names=['sepal_length', 'sepal_width', 'petal_length', 'petal_width', 'species'])

# Map species to numerical values for plotting
species_map = {'setosa': 1, 'versicolor': 2, 'virginica': 3}
data['species'] = data['species'].map(species_map)

# Create a new figure
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))

# Create a scatter plot with different colors for species
sns.scatterplot(x='sepal_length', y='petal_length', hue='species', data=data, palette='viridis')

# Add axis labels and title
plt.xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)')
plt.ylabel('Petal Length (cm)')
plt.title('Iris Species Classification')

# Add legend
plt.legend(title='Species')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd

data = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv', names=['sepal_length', 'sepal_width', 'petal_length', 'petal_width', 'species'])
